div.head: Cons Cn II 19.2d
div.ab: Decimatio autem est que alicubi dicitur uulgo warda — id est obseruatio: scilicet sub una societate urbem uel centenarium debet seruare —, alicubi dicitur borch — id est fideiussor, propter superius dictam causam, scilicet fideiussionem communem —, alicubi uero decimatio, quia X ad minus debent inesse.]
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 618–619 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
